name: Buzzing Bridge
description: Gives any sound the buzz of a curved bridge, a membrane, loose shells, leather or paper: set off by its level and pitch, and brighter as it dies away.

params.name: Model
params.description: What the sound touches: a curved bridge whose buzz climbs as a note dies, a membrane that wakes on loud notes, shells knocked by attacks, a leather strip or paper.

params.name: Amount
params.description: How firmly the sound is touched. A little catches only the crest of each swing and leaves a thin edge; a lot is a broad buzz nearly as loud as the sound.

params.name: Threshold
params.description: How loud a note must be before it touches. Softer notes stay exactly as they were; in Membrane the buzz also grows with how far a note rises over it.

params.name: Curve
params.description: Grazing: how far the buzz climbs as a note dies. Membrane: how late it speaks up. Shell: how fast bounces crowd together. Leather and Paper: how hard the touch is.

params.name: Tracking
params.description: How closely the buzz follows pitch. Down, it keeps to its own place and only level moves it; up, it sits on the partials of the note and moves as the note does.

params.name: Resonance
params.description: Where the thing that buzzes rings: low is a big soft membrane or shell, high a small tight one. On the bridge it is the height the climb stops at.

params.name: Rattle
params.description: How long an attack keeps the touch bouncing. For Loose shell this is all there is; the others settle into a steady buzz once it is over.

params.name: Bounces
params.description: How many times the touch strikes after an attack, each sooner and softer than the last. One is a single knock, or no chatter before the steady buzz.

params.name: Fall
params.description: How the buzz dies after the sound. Short, it sinks sooner than the note does; long, it holds on while the note fades away beneath it.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Takes the top off the buzz and leaves the sound itself alone. Low is felt and wood, high is wire and glass.

params.name: Distance
params.description: Moves the buzz into the next room while the sound stays here: duller, later, softer and with walls round it.

params.name: Width
params.description: Spreads the buzz around the sound, which stays where it is. Down, the buzz comes from exactly where the sound comes from.

params.name: Mix
params.description: How much of the buzz is laid over the untouched sound. The sound itself is never turned down or delayed.

params.name: Output
params.description: The level of everything that comes out, the sound and its buzz together.

meters.name: How far the touch is closed

origin.note: Written for live-mix. Contact buzz as an effect: the contact works on a low-passed copy of the sound normalised to its own envelope, four times oversampled, and only what it adds is put beside the untouched sound.
